readings: The cases of the study, their deciding checks, their classes at baseline and the tests that pass at baseline are read from the deposited base-1.json of the toolkit (section 3: the same cases and records); the base-1.json of the mutant runs is compared with it, message texts aside.

A test is identified across suite runs by its key without the leading '<run>|' (4.3: a test that runs in several suite runs is 1 test); --without-tests and the OLD of --replace remove that test from every suite run.
The kills of a completed whole-suite run are the tests listed as lost in its run record: the tests that pass in both unmodified whole-suite runs and do not pass on the mutant copy.
A mutant whose whole-suite run is 'timeout' or 'error' after the repeat is killed by the suite and gives no kill to any test; it stays killed when tests are removed.
An extra test kills a mutant only in a completed extra run (4.3 'Killed by a variant'); an extra run that is 'timeout' or 'error' kills nothing.
Counts of mutants are of tool mutants; the deletions are reported apart in every table, and M1, M2 and M3 are decided on tool mutants, with the deletion of the relevant check reported beside them.

Case detection follows the toolkit: an observed case is detected when the oracle holds at baseline and not on the mutant copy; a crashed case is detected under every oracle (under O_T only for a case with a target); withheld and missing cases are not detected in the main columns; a recorder run that is 'timeout' detects in every case under every oracle; a recorder run that is 'error' gives no value and is left out of the per-case groups.
O_S for 1 case detects when the case's own test passes at baseline and not in the mutant's recorder run, or when the case is crashed.

Mutant-level detection: an oracle detects when it detects in an observed case of the study; a crashed case anywhere is a detection under every oracle, O_T included; O_S detects when a test that holds a case of the study passes at baseline and not in the recorder run, or a case crashed; 'suite' detects when any test that passes at baseline does not pass in the recorder run.
'The test of the case does not pass in the recorder run' is true for a recorder run that is 'timeout' and has no value for a recorder run that is 'error'.
The lines a mutant changes are found by comparing the modified file with the file of the clone, line by line ('\n' ends a line); they are compared with the column changed_lines of mutants.csv.

The span of a check: for each raise statement, its lines and the lines of its innermost guard, found as reach.checks.guard_of finds it: the nearest enclosing 'if' statement of which the raise is not in the test (the lines of the test expression), or the nearest enclosing 'except' clause (from the 'except' line to the last line of the exception type, or the 'except' line alone when the clause names no type).

The function of a check covers the lines of the definition that checks.json names, from its first decorator to its last line; a tool mutant lies in it when it changes at least 1 line and every changed line is in that range.

Comparison cases: cases of the study whose rule-2 target is their deciding check, whose target is a check of a mutated file, and whose case key is not the case of a shadowed row; rows of other kinds do not make a case shadowed.

Rows of the cases file whose kind neither starts with 'shadowed' nor is 'comparison' are reported apart under 'other_kinds', with the same tables and with M1 to M3 computed over them, and take no part in the shadowed results.

M3, 'fires in no case of the baseline': the check is neither among the fired checks nor the deciding check of any recorded execution of an included block in the deposited base-1.json; the same over the cases of the study is reported beside it.
M3, 'the suite with the variant': the whole suite with the variant added; where the whole suite does not kill the deletion, adding the variant and replacing the test by it give the same result.

For the library, 'the same without the tests that hold a shadowed case' and 'with each such test replaced by its variant' are computed both from --without-tests and --replace as given, and from the rows of the cases file.
